panels.title: CPU Usage Breakdown (User, System, I/O Wait, Steal, Idle)

targets.query: from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_metrics" and (r._field == "user_percent" or r._field == "system_percent" or r._field == "iowait_percent" or r._field == "steal_percent")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_metrics" and (r._field == "load_avg_1m" or r._field == "load_avg_5m" or r._field == "load_avg_15m")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_core_metrics" and r._field == "usage_percent") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
